name: OnDocumentRelease
caption: When a document is released (interactive)

configuration.description: Document table: Sales Header 36 or Purchase Header 38. Extensions can register more releasable tables. Known supported values: 36, 38. Extensions can register more, so other values are not rejected by this reference.
Run only in interactive client sessions; releases from background or service sessions are left untouched.
Maximum run time. The editor replaces values <= 0 with 30.
Field filters on the document header: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally (max 250 chars, no placeholders).

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; tableNo = configuration.tableNo (declared as 'value' when tableNo is 0)

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be > 0. Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Pick the document table the flow should watch.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be a supported releasable document table. Hard stop at publish; also shown live in the canvas status line.
rules.message: Table %1 is not one of the supported releasable document tables.

rules.check: timeoutSec should be > 0 (the editor writes 30 for values <= 0).
Any error in the flow (e.g. an Error step) prevents the release and shows the flow's message.

notes: Fires on the MANUAL release of a Sales or Purchase document (the Release action), before any release work. Release previews never fire it. With guiOnly (default), non-UI sessions are skipped.

Synchronous and atomic: runs inline in the user's transaction, without commits. An error prevents the release. A Set document field values step writes values onto the header before it is released; with its 'Skip standard processing' option the header is saved with the flow's values and Business Central's own release is skipped (e.g. to set a custom Pending Approval status).
Because it runs outside a table event, a Confirm dialog step can ask the user; the release waits for the answer.
Re-entrancy guard: a release that the running flow itself performs does not start the flow again.
No watch fields: configuration keys watchFields / triggerOnInsert / triggerOnModify are not used by this trigger.
No recurring Job Queue entry; the registration is keyed by tableNo.
Picker filter: Set document field values is offered. Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name and Prevent page close are hidden.
